about: Analyst synthesis. For each function, episodes are grouped into configurations according to the kind of response their functional interpretation describes. Groupings drive the layout of the Functional repertoire view; they are not source facts and carry no scores. An episode appears only under functions for which functional-reading.json (or episodes-extra.json) has a reading.

mobilisation.label: Pooling shared resources
mobilisation.rationale: Associations bring money and purchase needs into a common pool.

mobilisation.label: Convening across sectors
mobilisation.rationale: Meetings and tables bring institutions, buyers and producers into contact.

mobilisation.label: Gathering local providers
mobilisation.rationale: Dispersed experience providers are brought around one offer.

knowledge.label: Technical know-how meets production
knowledge.rationale: Good practices, soil and crop information enter production routines.

knowledge.label: Territorial and cultural knowledge into an offer
knowledge.rationale: Nature, culture, food traditions and local stories are combined.

knowledge.label: Market requirements meet supplier capabilities
knowledge.rationale: Buyer, institutional and entrepreneurial perspectives are put side by side.

coordination.label: Shared financial and purchasing commitments
coordination.rationale: Allocation, repayment, aggregation and distribution must be aligned.

coordination.label: Value-chain articulation with buyers
coordination.rationale: Production improvement, supply and buyer agreements are interdependent.

coordination.label: Aligning a tourism offer and its enabling conditions
coordination.rationale: Services, costs, content and institutional conditions need recurrent alignment.

support.label: Collectively administered resources
support.rationale: The only curated episode read through mutual support. A thin evidence base is shown as such, not padded.
